scope: All 426 existing renderer contracts, expanded crowned/region/troop/captive/actual appointment cases, all 33 active sprite registrations and seven material registrations. Entries include aliases and shared systems, not this many distinct images.
limitations: The 513 cards include shared owners and aliases; they are not 513 independently generated sprite files. Every original before image is preserved.
Asset pairs use production procedural drawings at the default 150% camera with DPR 2 sampling. Texture swatches and shared surface diagrams retain their labeled scales.

Nine selected in-game scenes were captured before/after in desktop and phone browser layouts at 150%, including one Crown night scene. These bounded visual checks do not certify a complete campaign, every lighting/crowd combination, or a physical phone.

All 33 registered sprite images, both retained idle frame pairs, seven textures, their original sources, display anchors and timing remain unchanged. Comparison metadata now references the refined procedural fallbacks; prior registry revisions remain in history.
Combat-warning geometry is protected. The effects card remains a representative context review; this pass does not claim new artwork or a frame-by-frame audit for every VFX identity.
Earlier publication block is historical. Joel explicitly authorized merge and publication on 19 October 2026; this approval supersedes the prior local-only boundary.
Joel approved the entire completed design set on 19 October 2026, including the final corrected states. This is owner design acceptance, not a full gameplay certificate.

approval.scope: All 513 reviewed plans approved by Joel, including refinements, substantial rebuilds and keep/protect decisions.
approval.resultAppearanceAcceptance: Entire completed 513-entry design set, including all requested corrections and the shared overhead translucent TRUE boss crown.

correctionGroups.enemy:ashbeast: Tail root is now occluded behind the rear carapace; segmented sting arches above the body while preserving the front-facing eyes and claws.
correctionGroups.enemy:archer: A single open leather back quiver carries visible shafts and feathered nocks; duplicate sticks and exposed arrowhead-like forms are removed.
correctionGroups.boss:thorn: Replaced the back-growing branches with antler trophies lashed into cut sockets on a browband, with a suspended fang. Retained the woodland mantle and wolf anatomy.
correctionGroups.boss:crypt: Replaced the royal crown with a fitted dark cloth tricorn, including the miniature; TRUE form retains radiance without a crown overlay.
correctionGroups.boss:mire: Restored a fierce boss silhouette with tall sharp staggered spines, an angular brow, slit eye, open dark mouth and larger interlocking teeth.
correctionGroups.boss:citadel: Replaced the shovel-shaped weapon with a long pointed ridged spear and an actual shaft grip; fitted military headgear replaces the crown-shaped ornament.

subsequentReview.scope: Owner clarified that the translucent crown is a shared floating TRUE-form indicator for every boss. All eleven TRUE bosses now use the same design above their anatomy/headgear. Dark Lord retains his personal normal crown beneath it. TRUE boss label/culling headroom accommodates the overhead indicator; normal designs, scale and combat remain unchanged.

notes.true-regalia: Owner clarified that the translucent crown is a shared floating TRUE-form indicator for every boss. All eleven TRUE bosses now use the same design above their anatomy/headgear. Dark Lord retains his personal normal crown beneath it. TRUE boss label/culling headroom accommodates the overhead indicator; normal designs, scale and combat remain unchanged.

specialist:darklord.reason: Owner explicitly requested a proper visual overhaul of the previously retained unassigned Dark Lord-family smith, keeping him as a humorous reusable character with a real trade tool.

reviewHistory.scope: Joel requested distinct hero identities, rigid helmets, real quivers, varied NPC hair and expression, believable spear/staff/hammer/anchor, separated barracks desk, character-specific dungeon masters, Cinder Warlord mace and coherent profile direwolf riders across every loadout and tier. Revised drawings propagate through shared, crowned, captive, pet, appointed and fallback states where applicable. No acceptance of unseen revisions is claimed.

notes.boss:mire: Rebalanced Mirejaw after owner feedback: five shorter staggered dorsal plates, maximum height 14 instead of 31, retain angular eye, readable crocodile silhouette and strong jaw. Shared normal/TRUE/appointed bodies inherit the revision.
notes.shared:hero-paladin: Rigid paladin helmet with separate steel dome, brow, dark visor slit, ridged faceplate and gorget.
notes.shared:hero-mage: Clearly female silver-haired mage, bright eyes and warm expression, blue gown and moon hat.
notes.shared:hero-ranger: Blond ranger with visible hair and pointed goatee, stern brows, hood and real leather quiver.
notes.shared:ally-soldier: Rigid metal infantry helmet with visor and a distinct Pickelhaube-style spike.
notes.shared:ally-archer: Goblin archer restores folded green cap and feather, smaller nose, raised brow and sly half-smile, with a real quiver.
notes.crowned:mage: Restores the original blue-robed masked mage identity, purple mouth scarf and silver hair, with the crown fixed around the pointed mage hat.
notes.crowned:ranger: Golden hair is visible beneath the crown, with the same blond goatee and real quiver as the ranger.
notes.crowned:paladin: Royal paladin retains crown over a rigid fitted visor helmet.
notes.mounted-direwolf:lance: Both wolf and rider face right. Profile helmet and torso, hip seated in saddle, bent forward knee and hanging shin, one near stirrup and occluded far leg. Removes woodland boss trophies from the military mount. All guard/ringleader variants share this construction.
notes.mounted-direwolf:bow: Same coherent profile riding pose as lancer, with forward bow arm, real fletched quiver, reins and stirrup. All guard/ringleader variants share it.
notes.shared:captain-frontier-overseer: Cinder Warlord wields a socketed spiky iron mace and retains his officious ledger; raised brow, lopsided grin and short crest distinguish the captain from governor and common troops.
notes.pet:archive: Drowned Keeper carries a staff-anchor with visible ring, crossbar, curved arms and pointed flukes.
